text: 截至目前，ETF两市成交额报6372.88亿元，较昨日此时缩量858.11亿元，分类型来看，股票型ETF成交额1859.49亿元，债券型ETF成交额3020.13亿元，货币型ETF成交额548.24亿元，商品型ETF成交额118.59亿元，QDII型ETF成交额826.43亿元。其中，成交额最高的非货币型ETF分别是创业板ETF（159915）、科创50ETF（588000）、中韩半导体ETF（513310），成交额分别为：138.43亿元、129.66亿元、121.25亿元。
text_en: As of now, total ETF turnover in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets stands at 637.288 billion yuan, down 85.811 billion yuan from the same time yesterday. By category, equity ETF turnover was 185.949 billion yuan, bond ETF turnover 302.013 billion yuan, money market ETF turnover 54.824 billion yuan, commodity ETF turnover 11.859 billion yuan and QDII ETF turnover 82.643 billion yuan. Among them, the non-money-market ETFs with the highest turnover were ChiNext ETF (159915), STAR 50 ETF (588000) and China-Korea Semiconductor ETF (513310), with turnover of 13.843 billion yuan, 12.966 billion yuan and 12.125 billion yuan, respectively.
